title: Cruise LLC: ADS Software Error May Cause Crash (300 affected)
summary: Cruise LLC (Cruise) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) with software versions Delta/2023.01.12.00 and Delta/2023.02.09.00, prior to version Delta/2023.02.09.00-08.00.  The ADS system may inaccurately predict the movement of articulated vehicles such as buses and tractor trailers.

title: Cummins, Inc.: Generator Set Fuel Hose May Cause Gas Leak (15,622 affected)
summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain Onan QG 2800i, and Onan QG 2800i EVAP generator sets.  The fuel hose between the fuel filter and Injection Pump Module (IPM) may not be properly secured, which can cause a gas leak.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Windshield Wipers May Fail (57,504 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Freightliner Business-Class M2, FCCC Business-Class M2, FCCC S2G (FCCC Business-Class M2), FCCC S2RV, FCCC SC2 (FCCC Shuttle Chassis), 2021-2022 Freightliner 108SD, and Freightliner 114SD vehicles.  The windshield wiper linkages may break, causing the windshield wipers to fail.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Steering from Missing Tie Rod Fastener (306 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022 FCCC Shuttle Chassis, 2022-2023 FCCC RV Chassis, FCCC Van Chassis, Van Chassis Gas, 2023 Freightliner Cascadia, Freightliner Business Class M2, Thomas Built Bus School Bus Chassis, Western Star 4700, Western Star 47X, Western Star 4900, and Western Star 49X commercial buses.  The tie rod may be missing a fastener, allowing the steer arm to detach.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Taillights May Fail to Illuminate (10 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022 LFS vehicles.  The taillights may fail to illuminate when the headlights are activated.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: Loaded Bike Rack Obstructs Rear Lighting/FMVSS 108 (140 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2019-2021 D45CRTLE, J3500, and J4500 coaches, equipped with a rear-mounted bike rack.  The vehicle's rear lighting may be obstructed when bikes are installed on the bike rack.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Suspension Components May Fail (489 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2004-2005 Carrera GT vehicles.  The spherical joints that connect the wishbone suspension components on the front and rear axles can fail due to damage from mechanical stress and corrosion.

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: Windshield Frame May Detach in a Crash/FMVSS 208 (11 affected)
summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2023 MC20 Cielo vehicles.  The windshield frame bonding may be insufficient and allow the frame to detach in a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: ABS Module May Fail (30 affected)
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2023 XD60 and XDE60 60' articulated transit buses.  The anti-lock brake system (ABS) module may lose power during hard braking, causing the ABS system to fail.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Rearview Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (38 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2023 Model X vehicles equipped with a full self-driving computer 4.0 and running software release version 2023.2.200.  Weak camera signal strength may prevent the rearview image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Insufficient Wiring Protection May Cause Fire (3 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2023 X3-45 and X3-45 VIP Entertainer motor coaches. The grommet that protects the electrical power distribution cables passing through a metallic panel is insufficient, allowing the cables to chafe on the edges of the panel and potentially short circuit.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Missing Wiring Protection May Cause Fire (3 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2023 X3-45 VIP Entertainer motor coaches.  The grommet that protects the electrical power distribution cables passing through a metallic panel was not installed, allowing the cables to chafe on the edges of the panel and potentially short circuit.

title: General Motors, LLC: Rear HVAC Electrical Circuit May Overheat (150,830 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2003-2023 Chevrolet Express Cutaway and GMC Savana Cutaway incomplete vehicles equipped with wiring for an optional rear heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) system.  When the HVAC blower motor circuit is left unused with exposed connectors and wiring, the circuit can corrode and overheat.

title: International Motors, LLC: HVAC Blower Motor Circuit May Overheat (42,054 affected)
summary: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2016-2017 International TranStar, 2017-2019 International ProStar, International LoneStar, 2017-2020 International DuraStar, WorkStar, and 2018-2019 IC Bus HC Commercial buses.  The heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) blower motor circuit may have an insufficient wiring terminal that can overheat.

title: Nikola Corporation: Parking Brake Valve Module May Cause Rollaway (364 affected)
summary: Nikola Corporation (Nikola) is recalling certain 2022-2024 TRE BEV trucks.  The electronic parking brake valve module (PVM) may fail to move into the park position when the parking brake is activated.

title: Ducati North America: Passenger Foot Pegs May Break (293 affected)
summary: Ducati North America (Ducati) is recalling certain 2023 Diavel V4 motorcycles.  The right and/or left side passenger foot pegs may break while mounting or riding the motorcycle.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Incorrect Rear Taillights Installed/FMVSS 108 (5 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2023 Land Rover Range Rover Sport vehicles.  The vehicles are equipped with incorrect rear taillights that do not illuminate correctly.  In addition, the brake lights may not illuminate correctly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, " Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Insufficiently Welded Second-Row Seat Frame (500 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Land Rover Range Rover vehicles equipped with seven seats.  The second-row left seat frame may have been insufficiently welded.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Lock Tab Missing from Head Restraint/FMVSS 202 (235 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2023 X5 sDrive40i, X5 xDrive40i, X5 M50i, X5 M and X5 xDrive45e vehicles.  The head restraints for the second-row outboard seats may have been improperly manufactured without locking tabs in the guide sleeves.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 202, "Head Restraints."

title: Lightning eMotors Inc.: High-Voltage Battery Failure (148 affected)
summary: Lightning eMotors Inc. (Lightning) is recalling certain 2020 FE4-86 and FT3-43, 2019-2021 FE4-129, and 2019-2022 FT3-86 vehicles.  The battery packs may have defective structural welds and experience an internal radiator leak, causing battery failure.

title: Forest River Bus, LLC: Improperly Secured Ceiling Panels/FMVSS 221 (29 affected)
summary: Forest River Bus, LLC (Forest River Bus) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Starcraft Prodigy school buses.  The interior panels on the ceiling may be improperly secured.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 221, "School bus body joint strength."

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Adaptive Cruise Control May Cause Sudden Braking (236 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2020-2023 VNR Electric vehicles equipped with Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC).  When the adaptive cruise control braking activates under light load conditions, it can trigger an aggressive braking response.

title: Alamo Group Inc.: Water Tank Strap May Detach From Vehicle (542 affected)
summary: Alamo Group, Inc. (Alamo Group) is recalling certain 2014-2019 Super Products Camel and Mud Dog vehicles.  The tie rod could disconnect from the water tank strap, allowing the water tank strap to detach from the top of the vehicle.

title: Buell Motorcycles Co.: Improper Installation of Index Spring (30 affected)
summary: Buell Motorcycles (Buell) is recalling certain 2021-2022 1190 RX and SX motorcycles.  The index spring may be installed improperly.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: Damaged Tire Bead May Cause Loss of Air Pressure (4,409 affected)
summary: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2023 Ascent vehicles equipped with 20-inch wheels.  The internal tire bead may have been damaged during the wheel mounting process.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Steering from Missing Tie Rod Fastener (48 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2023 Thomas Built Buses SAF-T-LINER SAF-T-LINER C2 Jouley, Thomas Built Buses SAF-T-LINER EFX, Thomas Built Buses SAF-T-Liner HDX, Thomas Built Buses Chassis and 2023-2024 School Bus Chassis school buses.  The tie rod may be missing a fastener, allowing the steer arm to detach.

title: Meritor, Inc.: Steer Axle Fasteners May Come Loose (65 affected)
summary: Meritor, Inc. (Meritor) is recalling certain front drive steer axles, models MFS and FF, with part numbers MFS20133ANK66, MFS20133ANK86, and FF961LX296.  The front-drive steer axle fasteners may loosen, resulting in a complete separation of the axle assembly joints.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Second-Row Seat Belts May Malfunction (1,465 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2023 X1 xDrive28i, X1 M35i vehicles.  On the second-row outboard seats, the seat belts may have been pinched by an interior trim panel during vehicle assembly.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Engine Crankcase Cover May Leak Oil (1,461 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023 Rebel 300 (CMX300) motorcycles.  The right engine crank house cover was incorrectly painted, allowing the press-fit plug to fall out.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Incorrect PCM Software May Cause Engine Stall (131,700 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021 Ram 1500 vehicles equipped with 5.7L eTorque engines.  The powertrain control module software may cause an incorrect fuel mixture condition in the engine, and result in an engine stall.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): High Pressure Fuel Pump Failure (9,327 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar High Pressure Fuel Pumps with part number 68501449AA and certain 3.0L Diesel Engines with part numbers 05162119BB, 05162111CB, 05158048AH, and 05158052AG.  The high pressure fuel pump (HPFP) may fail.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Solar Panel Mounting Hardware May Loosen (2,616 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021 Forester 2401BSD, FR3 F3A32DSF, Georgetown GTA36K7, 2022-2023 East to West Entrada, 2023 East to West Alta, Coachmen Apex, Brookstone, Chaparral and Chaparral Lite, Forest River Crusader, Sanibel, Shasta Phoenix, Coachmen Spirit, and East to West Tandara vehicles.  The solar panel mounting hardware may become loose and pull through the slot in the panel.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): High Pressure Fuel Pump Failure (45,832 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Jeep Wrangler, Gladiator, and 2022-2023 Ram 1500 vehicles equipped with a 3.0L diesel engine.  The high pressure fuel pump (HPFP) may fail.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Missing Air Bag Sensors (37 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022 Ram 1500 vehicles.  The B-pillar impact sensors may be missing, which can result in delayed air bag deployment or non-deployment.

title: General Motors, LLC: Brake Pressure Switch May Short and Cause Fire (40,428 affected)
summary: General Motors. LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Chevrolet 4500HD, 5500HD, and 6500HD Medium-Duty trucks.  The brake pressure sensor assembly may leak brake fluid into the brake pressure switch and cause an electrical short-circuit.

title: Field Van, Inc: Corrosion on Remote Control Circuit Board (20 affected)
summary: Field Van, Inc (Field Van) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Sprinter vehicles, equipped with a Warn Winch and a wireless handheld remote.  Water may enter the handheld remote control for the winch and cause circuit board corrosion, which can allow the winch to operate unintentionally.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Driver's Powered Seat May Not Be Secure (12,400 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2023 Rogue, Pathfinder, and Infiniti QX60 vehicles.  The driver's powered seat may not be fully secured to the seat frame, causing the seat frame welds to detach from the rear inboard seat bracket.

title: Michelin North America, Inc.: Insufficient Traction for Snow Tires/FMVSS 139 (542,110 affected)
summary: Michelin North America, Inc. (Michelin) is recalling certain Agilis CrossClimate C-Metric tires with DOT codes 0117 through 1423.  Please see the attached tire chart for a list of all affected sizes.  The tires are labeled as snow tires, but do not have sufficient traction to perform in all snow weather conditions.  As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."

title: Winnebago Towable: Bumper Mounted Spare Tire Carrier May Detach (10,492 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Micro Minnie travel trailers.  The spare tire carrier may fail when loaded with a certain off-road style tire.

title: 3M Transportation Safety Division: Inadequately Reflective Conspicuity Tape/FMVSS 108 (244 affected)
summary: 3M Transportation Safety Division (3M) is recalling certain Flexible Prismatic Conspicuity Tape, Series 913-72 retroreflective sheeting, with part number 913-72 (red) and lot number DG23732.  The conspicuity tape may not be adequately reflective at certain angles.  As such, this equipment fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Seat Cushion May Detach From Frame (280 affected)
summary: Prevost Cars (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2021-2023 X3-45 Commuter busses.  The foldable passenger seat cushion bolts may be loose and could fall out, allowing the seat cushion to detach from the seat frame.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Improperly Welded Seat Frames/FMVSS 210 (280 affected)
summary: Prevost Cars (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2021-2023 X3-45 Commuter buses.  The foldable passenger seat frames may have been improperly welded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Tires May Have Tear in Inner Bead (4,249 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2023 Titan and Frontier vehicles.  The tires may have a tear in the inner bead which can cause a rapid loss of tire pressure.

title: Airstream, Inc.: Generator Set Fuel Hose May Cause Gas Leak (142 affected)
summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2023 Rangeline motorhomes, equipped with certain Cummins EVAP generator sets.  The fuel hose between the fuel filter and Injection Pump Module (IPM) may not be properly secured, which can cause a gas leak.

title: Mazda North American Operations: Damaged ABS Hydraulic Control Unit (2,410 affected)
summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2022-2023 CX-30 and 2023 CX-50 vehicles.  The anti-lock brake system (ABS) Hydraulic Control Unit (HCU) may be damaged, which can result in reduced braking ability.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: School Bus May Reverse Faster than Expected (419 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2018-2021 All American and Vision School Buses, equipped with PowerDrive 7000 electric drive systems.  The System Control Module (SCM) may activate the anti-rollback feature, causing the vehicle to reverse faster than expected when the vehicle is in reverse and pointing downhill with the brake pedal not applied.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Incorrect Emergency Exit Window/FMVSS 217 (40 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2014 LFS and 2012-2013 LFS Artic transit buses.  The emergency exit window release and label may have been installed in the incorrect location.  In addition, the emergency exit window opening may be insufficient.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC: Incorrect Tire Information on Label/FMVSS 120 (100 affected)
summary: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC (Heartland)) is recalling certain 2023 Big Country and Big Horn fifth wheels.  The federal certification label may have incorrect tire information.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, " Wheels and Rims-Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: Triple E Recreational Vehicles: Bed Bracket May Fail Causing Injury (154 affected)
summary: Triple E Recreational Vehicles (Triple E) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Wonder W24RTB motorhomes.  These vehicles may have an incorrectly installed bed stay bracket, which can fail.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: High Voltage Battery Pack May Short Circuit (125 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2020-2024 VNR Electric vehicles.  The coolant line in the high voltage battery pack may not be fully seated and locked, which can result in the loss of coolant and an electrical short circuit.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: High Voltage Battery Pack May Short Circuit (4 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LR Battery Electric vehicles.  The coolant line in the high voltage battery pack may not be fully seated and locked, which can result in the loss of coolant and an electrical short circuit.

title: Ford Motor Company: Improperly Tightened Wheel Lug Nuts (1,434 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 Bronco and Ranger vehicles.  The lug nuts on the driver's side wheels may have been improperly tightened.

title: Les Technologies Ecotuned inc.: Charging Harness May Short Circuit (143 affected)
summary: Les Technologies Ecotuned Inc. is recalling certain 2018-2023 E85 MK3 EV conversion systems, with part number H211-209-V02-R00.  The charging harness may have a defective spliced connection in the AC power line.

title: International Motors, LLC: Brake Pressure Switch May Short and Cause Fire (9,170 affected)
summary: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2017-2023 International CV trucks.  The brake pressure switch assembly may leak brake fluid into the brake pressure switch's electrical components and cause an electrical short-circuit.

title: Thor Motor Coach: Generator Set Fuel Hose May Cause Gas Leak (2,919 affected)
summary: Thor Motor Coach (TMC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Sequence, 2021-2024 Rize, Scope, Tellaro, 2023-2024 Dazzle, and Twist motorhomes, equipped with certain Cummins Onan QG 2800i generator sets.  The fuel hose between the inline fuel filter and the injection pump module (IPM) may have inadequate clamp force, possibly resulting in a gasoline leak.

title: Crysteel Manufacturing Inc: Corrosion on Remote Control Circuit Board (59 affected)
summary: Crysteel Manufacturing Inc (Crysteel) is recalling certain 2021-2023 dump body vehicles built on Isuzu NRR-Series chassis, equipped with a Warn Winch and a wireless handheld remote.  Water may enter the handheld remote control for the winch and cause circuit board corrosion, which can allow the winch to operate unintentionally.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Generator Set Fuel Hose May Cause Gas Leak (1,027 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Coachmen Galleria, Beyond, Forester, Sunseeker, and 2021-2024 Nova motorhomes, equipped with certain Cummins Onan QG 2800i, and Onan QG 2800i EVAP generator sets.  The fuel hose between the inline fuel filter and the Injection Pump Module (IPM) may have inadequate clamp force, possibly resulting in a gasoline leak.

title: Shred-Tech Corporation: Shredded Paper May Accumulate and Cause a Fire (14 affected)
summary: Shred-Tech Corporation (Shred-Tech) is recalling certain 2021-2023 MDS-4-33 shredding trucks.  Shredded paper may accumulate in the space between the cutting knives and the bulkhead wall.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Brakes May Be Wired Incorrectly (37 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023 Salem and Wildwood travel trailers.  The brakes may be incorrectly wired, which can result in a loss of brake function.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Slide-Out Adjustment Arm May Puncture Tire (137 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2022 Columbus CMF299RL fifth wheel vehicles.  The riser tube was not installed between the axle hangers, causing inadequate clearance for the tires.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Cargo Carrying Capacity (64 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023 East to West Della Terra & Silver Lake travel trailers.  The Federal Placard may have been printed with incorrect dry weight and cargo carrying capacity.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: High Voltage Battery Pack May Short Circuit (7 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LFS battery electric transit buses.  The coolant line in the high voltage battery pack may not be fully seated and locked, which can result in the loss of coolant and an electrical short circuit.

title: Dana Incorporated: Axle Pinion Tail Bearing Seizure (11 affected)
summary: Dana Incorporated (Dana) is recalling certain Spicer Ultimate Dana 60 Bracketless Crate Axles sold for Jeep Wrangler vehicles.  The axel suspension bracket may prevent sufficient lubrication from reaching the pinion tail bearings.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: Brake Light Switch Malfunction/FMVSS 108 & 102 (4,030 affected)
summary: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2023 Impreza vehicles.  The brake light switch may be improperly adjusted and illuminate the brake lights without application of the brake pedal.  The vehicle may also allow drivers to start and shift the transmission out of the PARK position without pressing the brake pedal.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment" and 102, "Trans Shift Lever Seq/Starter Interlock/Trans Braking Effect."

title: Indian Motorcycle Company: Missing Belt Guard Reflector/FMVSS 108 (4 affected)
summary: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2022 Indian Chief Bobber, Indian Chief Dark Horse, and Indian Chief Bobber Dark Horse motorcycles.  These motorcycles may be missing a belt guard reflector.  As such, these motorcycles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: HV Battery Cell Monitoring Circuit Not Secured (31 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022-2024 iX xDrive50 and 2023 i4 eDrive35, i4 eDrive40, and i4 M50 Hybrid Electric vehicles.  The high voltage battery cell monitoring circuit may have improperly secured electrical connections which can result in an engine stall.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Catalytic Converter and Exhaust Fasteners May Fail (5 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2023 X7 M60i and XM vehicles.  The fasteners that connect the exhaust system and the catalytic converter may not have been tightened correctly.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Incorrect Information in Owner's Manual/FMVSS 103 (94,343 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2013-2017 LEAF vehicles.  The Owner's Manual instructions for defroster operation are incorrect and may result in reduced defroster performance under specific conditions.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 103, "Windshield Defrosting and Defogging Systems."

title: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc.: Incorrectly Installed Spare Tire Carrier (203 affected)
summary: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Cahaba motorhomes.  The spare tire carrier and molle rack may be incorrectly installed on the rear van doors, which can cause them to detach while the vehicle is in transit.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Blank LCD Display/FMVSS 101 & 138 (108,936 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023 Sportage, Sportage Hybrid, Sportage Plug-in Hybrid, Niro Hybrid, Niro Plug-in Hybrid, Soul, and Telluride vehicles equipped with a digital instrument cluster containing a 4.2" LCD screen.  The instrument cluster may fail to display any information when the vehicle is started.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays," and 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Vehicle May Understeer/FMVSS 136 (266 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain short wheelbase 2020-2024 Freightliner Cascadia, 2021-2024 Freightliner M2 Business Class, 2022 Western Star 4700, and 2020 Freightliner Classic Cascadia vehicles.  The vehicle is equipped with an electronic stability control system and tire combination that may understeer during a J-turn.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 136, "Electronic Stability Control Systems on Heavy Vehicles."

title: Hyundai Motor America: Rear Driveshafts May Fracture (1,790 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2023 Genesis GV60 vehicles equipped with an all-wheel drive powertrain system.  The rear driveshafts may fracture, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Unsecured Transmission May Cause Rollaway (165,503 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Ram ProMaster vehicles equipped with a 62TE transmission.  The park pawl may not fully engage the park gear due to debris inside the transmission.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Drive Power from Damaged PTU (25,980 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Jeep Cherokee vehicles.  The power transfer unit (PTU) may become damaged and disengage the transmission and differential, resulting in a loss of drive power or loss of park function.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Unsecured Fuse inside High Voltage Battery (2,564 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Jeep Wrangler Plug-In Hybrid Electric vehicles (PHEV).  The high voltage (HV) battery pack assembly was built with incorrect fasteners to secure the 200-amp fuse, which can generate excessive heat.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Unsecured Fuse inside High Voltage Battery (220 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar SVCE KIT- HYBRID BATTERY PACKS with part number 68488244AA.  The high voltage (HV) battery pack assembly was built with incorrect fasteners to secure the 200-amp fuse, which can generate excessive heat.

title: Lordstown EV Corp: Instrument Cluster Display Screen May Freeze (5 affected)
summary: Lordstown EV Corp (Lordstown) is recalling certain 2023 Endurance vehicles.  The instrument cluster display screen may freeze on initial startup and not display critical safety information.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rearview Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (523 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Explorer Police Interceptor Utility vehicles equipped with a 12.1-inch Integrated Computer Screen (ICS).  When the Display On/Off Button is used to turn the display to "Off" prior to placing the vehicle in reverse, the backup camera rearview image will not appear on the display.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Ford Motor Company: Replacement Air Bag Inflator Incorrectly Installed (231,942 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2004-2006 Ranger vehicles that received replacement front passenger air bag inflators under a previous recall.  The replacement front passenger air bag inflators may have been installed incorrectly.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Generator Set Fuel Hose May Cause Gas Leak (6,536 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Travato, 2021-2023 Solis, and 2022-2023 Ekko motorhomes, equipped with certain Cummins Onan QG 2800i, and Onan QG 2800i EVAP generator sets.  The fuel hose between the fuel filter and Injection Pump Module (IPM) may not be properly secured, which can cause a gas leak.
